name: Rekviyem po 7 Dney Leta
source:
Summer of 1989. Pioneers' Camp "Sovyonok".
For Semyon Persunov, the son of Soviet diplomats, a "privileged kid" burdened with a fatal illness, this camp session will be unlike any other.

For the first time in years of struggling with the mysterious "PSR Syndrome", his mind is finally free from foreign intrusions. And it is during this one precious week that he meets the one who will change everything - the Japanese singer Hatsune Miku, who becomes his last hope… and his future.

In just seven days of freedom, Semyon manages to save Slavia’s puppy, help Miku come to terms with her future, and convince Ulyana not to follow in his tragic footsteps.
But as the camp draws to a close, a sense of incompleteness begins to grow inside him.

And then, one evening, he hears from the Japanese girl the words he feared most…
translation:
1989年夏天。“Sovyonok”先锋营。
对于苏联外交官的儿子谢苗·佩尔苏诺夫（Semyon Persunov）来说，他是一个身患绝症的“特权孩子”，这次训练营将与其他训练营不同。

与神秘的“PSR综合症”斗争多年以来，他的思想终于摆脱了外来入侵。正是在这宝贵的一周里，他遇到了将改变一切的人——日本歌手初音未来，她成为了他最后的希望……以及他的未来。

在短短7天的自由时间里，谢苗设法拯救了斯拉维亚的小狗，帮助米库接受她的未来，并说服乌里安娜不要追随他悲惨的脚步。
但随着训练营即将结束，一种不完整的感觉开始在他内心滋长。

然后，一天晚上，他从日本女孩那里听到了他最害怕的话……
